notes.title: Patch 1.2 Update
notes.content:
Changes:
- Changed ground fog colour for Folded Reef and Mathematical Thorax.
- The terrain colour now changes according to how close the player is to it to highlight that a player is too close to the terrain.
- Shadows are turned on by default for new players.
Bug fixes:
- Fixed a bug where the invert movement setting is not saved upon exiting the game.
